name: outlook
description: Read-only access to local classic Outlook mail and calendar via COM, saving an email to the knowledge base when you ask for it. Windows only; requires pywin32.

search_folders.title: Search folders
search_folders.description: Optional. Comma-separated folder names for outlook_search_recent, e.g. 'Inbox,Sent Items,Archive'. The Python interpreter and the folder saved email goes to come from the suite-wide EVA_PYTHON and EVA_KNOWLEDGE_DIR environment variables - this server writes into the 'email' sub-folder of the knowledge root, which must exist; see the plugin README.

blacklist_file.title: Blacklist file
blacklist_file.description: Optional. Path to a file of extra content-blacklist terms, one per line.
